evals.name: detect-platform
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, explain how you would determine the test platform of a project.
evals.expected_output: Inspect global.json, project and props package references and project-system settings.
assertions: Checks package references and properties in the project and Directory.Build files.
Reports the evidence found rather than assuming.

evals.name: conflicting-config
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, VSTest and MTP properties conflict. What do you report?
evals.expected_output: Report the conflict and the effective runner.

evals.name: xunit-v2
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, a repo uses xunit v2 on VSTest. What follows?
assertions: States xunit v2 runs on VSTest.
Mentions bridge settings only if present.
